title: Keep multidimensional efficiency dimensions observable
narrative: Nubble starts the CLI host with family `pass_through` and backend `mock`. Nubble needs tool calls, tokens, latency, and coordination cost kept as separate efficiency dimensions rather than a single opaque proxy. Accepts FineEnvs tool-call efficiency observations[^fineenvs-efficiency].
implementation: `EfficiencyScorecard` and `build_efficiency_scorecard` in `mechaharness.efficiency_scorecard` compose topology/cost/coordination/resume dimensions without silent collapse.
validation: Harness `user_story` drives product verb(s) with environment `pass_through`/`mock`; hard expects on declared observation keys.

footnotes.label: FineEnvs multi-harness RL — tool calls and tokens
